# Figures for EW Fiscal 2004

## Non-United States Net Operating Loss

- **Tax Benefit Amount**: $13.9 million (Indefinite period)
- **Gross Net Operating Loss**: $29.3 million (Indefinite period)
- **Total (Gross Net Operating Loss)**: $64.6 million
- **Total (Tax Benefit Amount)**: $23.1 million

## Percentage Calculation

The percentage of the tax benefit compared to the gross net operating loss for the non-united states net operating loss of indefinite period is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Tax Benefit Amount}}{\text{Gross Net Operating Loss}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{13.9}{29.3} \right) \times 100 \approx 47.44\% \]
